LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.familyMarginal_fi: If the coordinates of a finite product space have product law ⊗ᵢ pᵢ, its marginal on any subset S of the index set is the product of precisely the laws pᵢ with i in S.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.isMutuallyIndepen: Under the product of finitely many finite probability laws pᵢ, every subset of the coordinates is mutually independent.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.isIndependentOf_f: For a finite product of finite laws, the coordinate projections at any two distinct indices i and j are independent random variables.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.entropy_finitePro: For a finite product of finite laws pᵢ, H(⊗ᵢ pᵢ) = ∑ᵢ H(pᵢ).
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.entropy_iid: For n independent draws from a finite law p, the joint entropy of the length-n word is nH(p), including n = 0.
LeanInfoTheory.Shannon.mutualInfo_map_pi: For a finite family of mutually independent coordinate pairs (Xᵢ,Yᵢ) with finite alphabets, the mutual information between the two vectors is I((Xᵢ)ᵢ;(Yᵢ)ᵢ) = ∑ᵢ I(Xᵢ;Yᵢ). The two variables within each pair may be dependent.
